Declassified intelligence report from 1952 concerning sightings of UFOs over Spain and French Equatorial Africa, specifically in places like Tangier, Espana (Spain), and Conakry, La Guinee Francaise (French Guinea).

1952: Strange Lights Over Spain 🇪🇸 and French Equatorial Africa 🇬🇳

In the tense early years of the Cold War, mysterious glowing objects streaked across the skies, sparking wonder and alarm from Europe to Africa.

Spain, April 21 🇪🇸

Four glowing spheres, shifting from red to bright yellow, zipped silently over Almansa at dawn—disappearing in less than a minute without a sound.

Spain, July 30 🇪🇸

Andújar residents spotted a fiery red “flying saucer” blazing through the night, trailing an eerie green glow—a sight that left locals buzzing with questions.

French Equatorial Africa, June 26 🇬🇳

Near Port Gentil, a cargo ship captain witnessed a glowing object loop above the harbor before diving toward the sea at incredible speed, prompting an official report.
